title: Faith Isn’t a Feeling
seo_title: Faith When You Don't Feel It (2 Corinthians 5:7) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Feelings are waves; faith is the anchor. A devotional on 2 Corinthians 5:7 about walking by faith when emotions don't cooperate.
verse_text: For we live by faith, not by sight.
insight: Feelings are waves. Faith is the anchor.
Faith is strongest when it walks forward without a spotlight.
one_minute_win: Whisper: "God, I trust You" several times today when doubt hits.
declaration: I walk by faith, not by mood.
